moment: The Mos Eisley cantina at its busiest
title: A Bear Walks Into Mos Eisley
story: Paddington was told this cantina served travelers from everywhere. Unfortunately, nobody understood his request for a marmalade sandwich.
world: The Mos Eisley cantina at its busiest: alien musicians, crowded booths, suspicious drinks, and one exceptionally polite visitor.

characters.name: Paddington Bear
quips: I do hope this isn't a rough establishment.
My emergency sandwich appears to have attracted a Jawa.
A hard stare should settle this quite nicely.
characters.line: Excuse me, does the blue milk come with marmalade?

characters.name: Luke Skywalker
quips: This place beats the moisture farm.
Ben says to keep my eyes open.
characters.line: I'm looking for a pilot, not sandwiches.

characters.name: Han Solo
quips: Passage costs extra for sticky paws.
Chewie, keep an eye on the sandwiches.
characters.line: Wrong guy. Mine's a vest, not fur.

characters.name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
quips: Be mindful of the company here.
A robe can conceal many things.
characters.line: This isn't the bear you're looking for.

characters.name: Greedo
quips: Someone here owes a lot of credits.
That furry one's not my bounty.
Keep your paws where I can see.
characters.line: No bear. I'm here for Solo.

hint.text: Look in the back-right booth, under a brown hood beside the glowing table lamp.
